# BuildRecordDeployedResource

One definition a deploy created, updated or left unchanged.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [`BuildRecordResourceKind`](build-record-resource-kind.md) | The kind of definition. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The definition's id. |
| `name` | `string` | The definition's name. |
| `version` | `integer \| null` | The definition's latest enabled version after the deploy; null for looms, which have no versions. |
| `mode` | [`BuildEntityMode`](build-entity-mode.md) | What the deploy did with it. |

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "Agent",
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "name": "...",
  "version": 0,
  "mode": "Created"
}
```

- Inside [`BuildRecord`](build-record.md)
